neighbours.label: 'mind you' and 'of course' set off after a complete clause, as opposed to other closing words after the same clause
fire: The food is cheap, mind you.
She never wrote back, mind you.
It is a fine old house, mind you.
The hotel sits near the beach, of course, so pack light.
Nobody there speaks French, of course, so learn a little.
The ending is happy, of course.
His car is old, mind you.
The museum closes on Mondays, of course.

She never wrote back, I hear.
It is a fine old house, I believe.
The hotel sits near the beach, so pack light.
Nobody there speaks French, so learn a little.
The ending is happy, thank you.
His car is old, you know.
The museum closes on Mondays, I think.
